name: GPT-Image (built-in)
description: LoadImage(reference) -> OpenAIGPTImage1(edit) -> Images to RGB -> RMBG -> SaveImage. Reference blueprint mirroring batch_atlas.build_workflow_gpt. The built-in gpt_image path keeps its dedicated Python builder (size/quality/background/match-ref logic + the gpt_prompt field); this blueprint is the canonical node SHAPE to copy when authoring a GPT-Image variant. CAVEAT: if driven via the generic runner the `positive` binding injects _resolve_text's combined prompt (NOT the region's gpt_prompt field) and the size/quality/background/match-ref logic is skipped — so a driven GPT blueprint won't match the built-in builder. Runs on comfy.org credits (the OpenAIGPTImage1 node self-authenticates). Owner-side verify owed.
